text: Ask Herzog Records for an owner-level AI-transformation diagnostic
description: Felix uses his existing Herzog Records relationship to request a 30-minute conversation with the owner or operating decision-maker. Public information suggests a small owner-led label with active 2026 releases, long-term artist development, media/contact follow-up, booking/stage activity, and grant applications. Treat these only as discovery hypotheses. Ask where the owner is the recurring integration layer; offer a paid diagnostic mapping one recent release, its dependencies, approvals, repeated information, delays, and human-only artistic or relationship decisions. Prefer private coordination/memory over autonomous external communication.
reflection: Created meta/ai-transformation-prospect-briefs.md from current public sources. Prepared owner questions around release orchestration, relationship follow-up, catalogue consistency, grant applications, and campaign learning while explicitly rejecting generic automated communication as a default. Proposed a private release-control diagnostic that preserves the owner's voice.

status.comment: Felix must choose and contact the trusted Herzog Records person; the system should not impersonate him or initiate outreach.
